facts.claim: The taluq has 57 villages and a population of 20,303 souls, of whom 5,611 are Coorgs, 13,256 other Hindus, 1,029 Muslims, and the rest belong to other castes.
facts.quote: with its five Ndds is twice the size of Mercara-taluq, but contains the same number of villages viz. 57 with a population of 20,303 souls, of whom 5611 are Coorgs and 13,256 other Hindus, 1029 Mussulmans and the rest belonging to other castes.

facts.claim: The taluq contains the largest and most productive cardamom jungles.
facts.quote: with the largest and most productive cardamom jungles.

facts.claim: Rice cultivation is so deficient that even the largest farms cannot produce enough rice for their own consumption, forcing ryots to buy rice for six months a year.
facts.quote: Rice cultivation, owing to the want of suitable land, is so deficient, that even the largest farms are not : able to produce sufficient rice for their own consumption; the ryots in general have to buy rice for six months in the year
